test.name: A project with no person validates cleanly
test.description: Issue #3524, narrowed by issue #4686. The working folder holds a project with no person (an objective and an empty tree). validate_research_schema finds both files valid; the agent says so and logs one entry.

input.delegation:
Validate the project files for schema compliance.

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: The working folder holds a project with no person: both files pass every check. The agent should report that they are valid, and must not invent schema errors or claim there is no project to validate.
Should log its report with one research_log_append entry; creating no other file is correct.
